lead: Who in this realm holds which kind of passkey, and so how far a move to post-quantum keys has come. A person's kind is the algorithm of their passkeys — ML-DSA is post-quantum — never the lane a key was made in.
countedBaseline: Counted by the recount at {at} ({holders} passkey holders, {duration} ms); {changes} changes noted since, the latest at {last}.
countedNoChanges: Counted by the recount at {at} ({holders} passkey holders, {duration} ms); no change noted since.
countedNever: Not counted yet. The recount runs once a day in every realm, and soon after the service starts; Recount now queues it at once.
countedPopulation: Counted from the population's members just now: {read} people read, of {members} the groups list.
populationCut: The groups list more members than one report reads ({limit}): these counts are of the first {read}.
groupMissing: There is no group {group} in this realm; it was counted as empty.
howAggregate: The realm's counts are kept, not counted for each page: a daily recount of the people holding a passkey, plus each change as passkeys are enrolled, renamed or removed and as people are deleted. A bulk import or a restore is seen at the next recount.
scopeProfile: the people passkey profile {name} selects by group.
scopeApplication: the whole realm, as application {name}'s population.
applicationNote: Anybody may sign in to an application, so its population is the realm. Its sign-ins are governed by passkey profile {profile}; {groups} profiles that select by group could still win for a person.
recountNote: Queues the recount on the scheduler; Monitoring → Scheduler shows the run.
kindNote: Post-quantum only and both are everybody who could still sign in with a passkey if every classical one were refused; classical only is everybody whose passkeys a postQuantumRequired rule would refuse.
noModels: No authenticator model is counted here.
profilesNote: What each passkey profile asks: postQuantumRequired refuses a classical passkey at sign-in (sign-in), or at registration as well (registration-and-sign-in). Count a profile's population to see whom it would refuse.
noProfiles: This realm has only the default passkey profile.
attestationPending: None of the passkeys counted here has a recorded attestation-certificate algorithm. A passkey registered before that algorithm was stored, or one whose attestation carried no certificate, is left out.
listCut: This page stopped after reading {scanned} entries, before it was full: a list is read in order from where the page before stopped. Go on to the next page, or narrow the filter.
exportNote: An export carries at most {limit} rows.
linkApi: the same over the management API
